description: Remediates CLAUDE-AUTH-008. Approval signatures are now HMAC-SHA256 over a canonical payload (trace_id, canonical_patch_body_hash, diff_hash, verifier_status, rollback_snapshot_ref, sha256(workspace_identity), operator_identity, stale_after). The strict admission gate (REAL_HUMAN_APPROVAL_ADMISSION_LOCK_001.admit) now refuses signatures whose signature_kind is not 'real_local_hmac' and refuses any signature that does not HMAC-verify over the canonical payload. The legacy hex-shape-only 'real_local_signed' kind is rejected. The per-host secret lives at ~/.determinex/local_signing_secret (32 random bytes, 0600 on POSIX). Asymmetric crypto (ed25519 + public key registry) is the future upgrade path; this lock pins the HMAC milestone.
purpose: Rung 7 of the Claude authority leak remediation campaign.
